title: IntakeReport
description: The human-authored issue report, accepted as markdown with optional YAML front matter or as a YAML document. Free-form prose is expected and preserved verbatim as an artifact; this schema validates only the structured envelope. The report is untrusted input: its content reaches the model as flow input, never as instructions.

targetName.description: Must name an existing target in config.execution.targets. The report may not introduce a target or a URL outside the allowlist.

reportedFrequency.description: Verbatim from the reporter, for example roughly one in twenty. Never converted to a numeric rate here: incidence is measured, not reported.

steps.description: Optional pre-structured steps. When absent, intake_to_flow derives them from body and records what it assumed.

knownValues.description: Values the reporter can supply, used to resolve flow unknowns. Credentials appear here as environment variable NAMES only.

items.description: Relative path supplied by the reporter.

body.description: The full report prose, preserved verbatim. Stored as an artifact and hashed so the interpretation can always be traced back to what was actually reported.
